title: Katbot.ai - Big Money Is Moving Into BTC
author: Any_Cod4002
selftext: Bitcoin’s drop to $58,035 on a 3-year high US PCE inflation print of 4.1% generated 113 articles in 24 hours with an average sentiment of -0.111 across the top ten tracked tokens. The coverage was uniformly negative — every major headline framed the move as a crash or manipulation — yet the onchain tape shows a different story. This is the widest gap we’ve seen this quarter between narrative and net flow.
